pages.title: Take it along
pages.text: Use a Portable Speaker to open the player.$(br2)It plays while carried in your inventory, including the hotbar or off hand.$(br2)Nearby players hear spatial audio from your moving position.

pages.title: Player controls
pages.text: Use Library, Playlist, Queue and Settings just like a placed Speaker.$(br2)Upload MP3/WAV, choose recordings or direct stream URLs, and control transport, repeat, range, volume and dropoff.

pages.title: Access & links
pages.text: Ownership and access rules still apply when an item changes hands.$(br2)Matching Speaker IDs link within one dimension.$(br2)The item has no block face, comparator output or adjacent ComputerCraft peripheral.

pages.title: Stored items
pages.text: Dropped items and stored items are silent.$(br2)Death, logout and dimension changes remove the old moving source.$(br2)Saved settings and playlists stay with the speaker identity.

pages.title: Return to listening
pages.text: Use Play to resume when necessary.
